summary: Completed comprehensive testing of Terra Farming iteration 2 features: Backend refactor to modular routers, Email triggers (mocked), Image uploads, Analytics, Coupons, Reviews. All 21 backend API tests passed. All frontend pages and components verified working correctly.
test_credentials: No authentication required for tested features. Guest user can browse products, add to cart, and checkout.
seed_data_creation: Existing seed data used: 32 products, 10 farms, 3 coupons (WELCOME10, SAVE50, FREEDELIVERY)
context_for_next_testing_agent: All iteration 2 features tested and working: Backend refactored to modular routers under /app/backend/routes/, Image upload endpoint accepts JPG/PNG/WebP/GIF and rejects other file types, uploaded files accessible via /api/files/{filename}, Email notifications are MOCKED (stored in MongoDB), Analytics dashboard shows revenue charts and overview cards, Farmer Management page has ImageUpload component in product dialog, Product detail page has reviews section with image upload capability, Checkout page has coupon input section with validation.
